portal_hypertension.title: Large esophageal varices predict hepatocellular carcinoma in newly diagnosed cirrhosis: insights from machine learning and propensity score analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Villa E, Guido D, Critelli RM
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 545）。核心观点：肝细胞癌（HCC）是慢性肝病（CLD）的主要并发症，需要改进风险分层。 临床提示：食管静脉曲张（EV）作为严重门静脉高压的表现，可能通过血管重塑和缺氧相关途径促进肝癌的发展。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a major complication of chronic liver disease (CLD) requiring improved risk stratification. Esophageal varices (EVs), as manifestations of severe portal hypertension, may promote HCC development through vascular remodeling and hypoxia-related pathways. We aimed to evaluate whether variceal size independently predicts HCC risk and whether specific biomarker profiles can be identified. In this 12-year prospective cohort study, 545 patients with newly diagnosed compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD) were enrolled at a tertiary hepatology center and followed for a median of 81 months. portal_hypertension.title: Anticoagulation in cirrhosis: Indications, drug selection, and disease-modifying potential.
portal_hypertension.authors: Téllez L, Guerrero A, Donate J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：除了防止血栓扩展和促进门静脉再通之外，越来越多的实验和临床证据表明，抗凝剂可能通过减弱肝内凝血、肝纤维化、窦性病变来发挥疾病缓解作用。 临床提示：除了防止血栓扩展和促进门静脉再通之外，越来越多的实验和临床证据表明，抗凝剂可能通过减弱肝内血栓来发挥疾病缓解作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Anticoagulation in cirrhosis has evolved from a perceived contraindication to an integral component of modern liver disease management. Recognition of the fragile rebalanced hemostatic state has challenged the traditional concept of cirrhosis as an exclusively hemorrhagic disorder and provided the biological rationale for anticoagulation in selected patients. Beyond preventing thrombus extension and promoting portal vein recanalization, accumulating experimental and clinical evidence suggests that anticoagulants may exert disease-modifying effects by attenuating intrahepatic coagulation, hepatic fibrogenesis, sinusoidal dysfunction, and portal hypertension. portal_hypertension.title: Effect of vasopressin and its analogues on microcirculatory perfusion: a systematic review.
portal_hypertension.authors: van Zwol J, Kruijsse JG, Vidal Itriago AA
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：虽然它可以恢复动脉压，但其对微循环的影响仍然不确定，可能会减少局部灌注和组织氧合。 临床提示：精氨酸加压素 (AVP) 是一种非肾上腺素血管加压药，越来越多地用于休克治疗。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Arginine vasopressin (AVP) is a non-adrenergic vasopressor increasingly used in the management of shock. While it restores arterial pressure, its effects on the microcirculation remain uncertain, with potential for reduced regional perfusion and tissue oxygenation. The aim of this systematic review is to evaluate the effects of intravenous AVP and its analogues on microcirculatory perfusion across different haemodynamic conditions and vascular beds. A systematic search of MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Web of Science was conducted. portal_hypertension.title: From Resection to Transplantation: Rethinking Training and Certification for the Modern HPB Surgeon.
portal_hypertension.authors: Moris D, Ziogas IA, Giorgakis E
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝胰胆（HPB）手术的发展已经超越了传统肝脏和胰腺切除术的范围。 临床提示：当代实践越来越多地涵盖先进的血管重建、受损肝脏的扩大肝切除术、恶性肿瘤移植以及多学科治疗后的复杂手术。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hepatopancreatobiliary (HPB) surgery has evolved beyond the confines of traditional liver and pancreatic resection. Contemporary practice increasingly encompasses advanced vascular reconstruction, extended hepatectomy in compromised livers, transplantation for malignancy, and complex operations following multimodality therapy. These developments have fundamentally altered the technical and cognitive demands placed upon HPB surgeons, raising an important question: which training pathway best prepares surgeons for the future of the specialty? portal_hypertension.title: Native Spleen T1 Mapping for the Assessment of Hepatic Congestion in Children With Congenital Heart Disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Tao K, Yamamura K, Sato M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 120）。核心观点：据报道，肝脏天然 T1 弛豫时间 (LT1) 与 CHD 中中心静脉压升高和肝损伤有关。 临床提示：先天性心脏病（CHD）中的充血性肝病可导致门静脉高压。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Congestive hepatopathy in congenital heart disease (CHD) can lead to portal hypertension. Liver native T1 relaxation time (LT1) was reported to be associated with elevated central venous pressure and liver injury in CHD. This study investigated the utility of spleen native T1 relaxation time (ST1) in children with CHD, particularly those with Fontan circulation, and its association with hemodynamic parameters and biomarkers of liver injury. This study included 120 patients with CHD (biventricular repair, 39; bidirectional Glenn shunt, 31; and Fontan circulation, 50) who underwent blood tests, cardiac catheterization, and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging performed within 48 h.
